teach_overlay.scale: raising your body temperature by just two degrees Celsius in a fever forces your cells to burn about twenty-five percent more energy — equivalent to jogging several miles without ever leaving your bed, a price evolution gladly pays because that extra heat supercharges your immune cells and starves bacteria of iron
